summary: Round 5 of the security review, delta only. The change over a4894ae adds a bounded retry to one gh call of pick-diffs.ts plus its tests, the adversarial round 3 tests, and text for spec D5 and the plan. The retry count is bounded at four tries, and a non-transient failure refuses at once. pick-diffs still runs only `gh api --method GET` with array arguments and no shell, and no new write path appears. The two single-file suites pass at HEAD. One Major stays open: a non-number or huge PICK_DIFFS_RETRY_WAIT_MS makes the retry wait block forever, because the code does not check the value. The round 2 nit P3B2-1 carries open.
nonblocking_findings: P3B5-1 [Major] review-b: the retry wait of pick-diffs.ts is not bounded against a bad PICK_DIFFS_RETRY_WAIT_MS. ghApi takes `const base = Number(process.env.PICK_DIFFS_RETRY_WAIT_MS ?? 5000)` (pick-diffs.ts:210) and calls waitSync(base * GH_RETRY_SCALES[attempt]) (pick-diffs.ts:202 and 226). A value that is not a number gives NaN and a huge value gives Infinity, and Atomics.wait blocks forever in both cases, so a transient gh failure hangs the tool instead of four tries and one refusal. Probes with `timeout 3 node -e ...`: Number("abc") is NaN and blocks, Number("1e999") and Number("Infinity") block, and Number("1e308") blocks, while 0 returns at once and the default 5000 waits its full bound. No script in the repo sets the variable (grep finds it only in pick-diffs.ts and in the tests, which set 0), so every shipped run uses the default and is bounded. Fix: clamp the base to a finite non-negative number, for example `const base = Number.isFinite(raw) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(raw, 60000)) : 5000`. Route to Green. Non-blocking because the trigger needs an operator-set bad value and a transient failure at the same time, and the data path stays correct when it happens.

P3B2-1 [Nit] review-b: nothing enforces the D9 order of the key SHA-256. review-set.ts still computes key_sha256 from the key bytes at lint time, and adjudicate.ts rewrites the key files after the lint, so a lint run before the apply publishes a hash that the apply invalidates. The delta of 2488905 touches neither file. The phase plan controls the order at task 4.13: the apply runs first, then the lint runs again, then the orchestrator commits the manifest. Carries rounds 2 to 4, and round 1 P3B1-6. Non-blocking.

F9 (P3B1-2 and the write path) rechecked and still closed: the pick-diffs.ts delta adds the transient patterns, the retry scales, lastStderrLine, reportGhStderr, waitSync, and the retry loop, and it adds no mkdirSync and no writeFileSync. The write path to <private>/candidates/<owner>__<name>.json is unchanged, the refuseSymlink guard at pick-diffs.ts:299 is unchanged, and the isPlainSetId guard at pick-diffs.ts:88-92 is unchanged.

The gh boundary holds: ghApi still builds the fixed argument array (api, --method, GET, path) and spawns it with no shell (pick-diffs.ts:202-205). The retry loop calls the same spawn, so every try is an api GET only, and the path always starts with repos/<owner>/<name>/. The P3T2 tests log every call in the fake gh log and count two calls for one transient failure and four calls for a permanent one, so the count is bounded at four tries.

The retry stops early on a non-transient failure: the loop refuses at once when the stderr does not match GH_TRANSIENT (pick-diffs.ts:222-224). Test P3T2-5 pins one call for a detail 404, and test P3T2-4 pins four calls and exit 2 with `pick-diffs: gh api failed` for a detail 502. No candidates file is written on either refusal.

F10 (P3B5-1) open: probes with `timeout 3 node -e ...` show that Atomics.wait blocks forever for NaN (the Number of "abc"), for Infinity (the Number of "1e999" or of "Infinity"), and for 1e308, while 0 returns at once. The code computes the base with Number and passes it to waitSync with no finite check (pick-diffs.ts:210, 202, 226). The default 5000 and the test value 0 are bounded, and grep finds PICK_DIFFS_RETRY_WAIT_MS only in pick-diffs.ts and in the tests, so the shipped runs are safe.

The stderr line cannot reach a public file: reportGhStderr writes the last non-empty line of gh stderr to the stderr of the tool (pick-diffs.ts:184-188). No script in the repo invokes pick-diffs yet (grep over harness/*.sh, harness/model-guide/*.sh, and harness/schedule-tests finds no call), so the line reaches only the terminal of the operator. No script of this track captures a tool stderr into a repo or a docs file; the writers of this track are the private folder, the public manifest, the public score file, and the queue files, and none reads a captured stderr. A gh error line names the API path, which holds the public repo names of spec D9, and gh prints no credential value.

The new tests use temp folders only and no network: the retry tests build a temp fake gh script with writeFileSync and chmodSync in a tempDir folder, put that folder first on PATH, set FAKE_GH_LOG and PICK_DIFFS_RETRY_WAIT_MS to 0 in a copied child environment, and use a 60 second timeout on each child (pick-diffs.test.ts:398-440). The adversarial round 3 tests spawn tsx with temp fake gh folders and check that a commits list over 64 MiB, a detail failure mid-run, and a truncated JSON tail each fail closed with no candidates file (adversarial-p3.test.ts P3X3-1 to P3X3-3).

The counts match the plan evidence of c867117 (pick-diffs 26, adversarial-p3 31, review-set 18).
